faq_heading: Homes near Douglas Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Douglas Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Douglas Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Douglas Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Douglas Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are South Meridian Elementary (3.1 km north-west), Peace Arch Elementary (3.6 km north-west) and Earl Marriott Secondary (4.2 km north-west).

Douglas Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 17325 2 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Montessori (K-7).
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Douglas Elementary.
How the Douglas Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Douglas Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 5 km of Douglas Elementary

8 schools in the provincial school list sit within 5 km of Douglas Elementary in a straight line (5 elementary, 3 secondary; 1 independent). The closest is South Meridian Elementary, 3.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Pacific Heights Elementary, 4.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Earl Marriott Secondary (4.2 km); the nearest independent school is St John Paul II Academy (4.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Peace Arch Elementary (3.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: South Meridian Elementary (3.1 km north-west), Peace Arch Elementary (3.6 km north-west), Edgewood Elementary (4.4 km north), White Rock Elementary (4.7 km north-west), Pacific Heights Elementary (4.9 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is South Meridian Elementary, 3.1 km north-west of Douglas Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Douglas Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Douglas Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Douglas Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Look at South Meridian Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 3.1 km north-west of Douglas Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
